title: Flaky: dispatch-geometry UNDELIVERED send-once test (CAM-375 AC6) falha intermitente sob carga do CI
description: test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts, teste 'UNDELIVERED wrapping payload: exactly one physical send-keys call (send-once guard, US-001, CAM-375), exactly one push-undelivered event with retriesExhausted maxAttempts (AC6)' e sensivel a timing (444ms, send-keys tmux REAL) e flaka sob carga do CI. Evidencia coletada no ciclo do PR #325 (CAM-399): PASSOU na run 1 do CI e FALHOU na run 2 do mesmo PR, e passa 3/3 local; um PR doc+config-only nao tem como afeta-lo. Causa: premissa de timing no teste (espera o esgotamento de retries por tempo). Fix: endurecer com waitForCondition / espera deterministica em vez de depender do timing de retry sob carga. Pre-existente; bloqueou um merge e forcou um re-run legitimo (com prova de flake, nao evasao). TIPO fix.

spec.scope: Fix the intermittent CI flake in test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts (the UNDELIVERED send-once tests, CAM-375 AC6/AC8 and CAM-364). Root cause: bootPane spawns the raw-echo fixture in a fresh tmux session and only awaits `has-session` (which succeeds the instant bun is spawned, before it renders its idle prompt), then returns. The tests immediately call the synchronous sendKeysVerified with idleTimeoutMs:100 (default pollIntervalMs:200, so only ~2 idle probes). Under CI load the fixture cold-start + first render + capture lag exceeds the 100 ms idle budget, so the pre-send waitForIdlePane gate times out and diverts to sendOnceUnverified, emitting push-undelivered{retriesExhausted:1, reason:'pane-not-idle'} plus an orch-pane-busy event instead of the asserted push-undelivered{retriesExhausted:3, reason:'retries-exhausted'} — flipping events.length 1->2 and failing the assertion. The fix is a deterministic wait in bootPane: after confirming the session exists, poll capture-pane on the private test socket via the already-imported waitForCondition until isOrchPaneIdle (already exported from src/tmux/dispatch.ts) returns true, so the fixture has provably rendered its idle prompt before any dispatch. This removes the race for the whole file at the setup layer, no production change. Out of scope: any change to production src/tmux/dispatch.ts, per-test idleTimeoutMs values, or the dedicated pane-not-idle test that intentionally wants the timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: bootPane, after confirming the tmux session exists, deterministically waits (via waitForCondition polling capture-pane on the private test socket) for the fixture pane to reach idle (isOrchPaneIdle true) before returning, so no test dispatches sendKeysVerified before the fixture has rendered its idle prompt. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The fix eliminates the pre-send idle-gate race for the UNDELIVERED tests at the setup layer: assertions can no longer flip to the pane-not-idle branch (retriesExhausted 1, reason pane-not-idle) because of a slow fixture cold-start under CI load; the deterministic idle-wait is the guarantee, not a raised idleTimeoutMs. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The change is confined to the test harness (bootPane setup); production src/tmux/dispatch.ts behavior is untouched, no per-test idleTimeoutMs values are altered, and no asserted event tuples are changed. The dedicated pane-not-idle test that intentionally wants the 100 ms timeout still constructs its own busy state and is unaffected. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
The full dispatch-geometry integration file passes. [oracle: bun test test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts]
The spine is green. [oracle: bun run check:all]
gotchas: The flake is NOT in the test body's waiting: there is none. sendKeysVerified is synchronous and void-returning; the events array is fully populated before the assertions run. Do NOT wrap the sendKeysVerified call in waitForCondition (nonsensical). The fix belongs in bootPane setup.

Root cause is bootPane returning before the fixture renders its idle prompt. The pre-send waitForIdlePane gate (dispatch.ts:428, idleTimeoutMs:100 with default pollIntervalMs:200 = only ~2 probes) then times out under load and diverts to sendOnceUnverified (dispatch.ts:479), which emits push-undelivered{retriesExhausted:1, reason:'pane-not-idle'} + orch-pane-busy instead of the asserted retries-exhausted tuple.

isOrchPaneIdle is already exported from src/tmux/dispatch.ts:317; import it alongside sendKeysVerified (test line 30). waitForCondition is already imported (test line 33) with default timeoutMs 5000 / intervalMs 20 (ample headroom, throws loud if the fixture genuinely never renders). Reuse both; add no new helper.

Capture pane content for the idle check on the PRIVATE test socket via the existing tmuxRaw(['capture-pane','-p','-t',SESSION]) (tmuxRaw is defined at line 47). Do NOT route the setup capture through makeSwapSocketSpawn.

Do NOT touch idleTimeoutMs:100 in the individual tests, do not alter any assertion tuple, and do not change production dispatch.ts. The dedicated pane-not-idle test (~line 330) with its explicit pollIntervalMs:20 WANTS the timeout; leave it and its intended warning ('did not go idle within 100 ms') alone.

This file is skipIf(!tmuxAvailable) and drives real tmux subprocesses; it runs on the host worker where tmux is present. In the run output, `did not go idle` warnings and any ✗ glyphs are fixture noise: read the 'N pass / N fail' summary line and the exit code, never grep for fail/error/✗.
domainTerms: sendKeysVerified: synchronous void-returning dispatch primitive (src/tmux/dispatch.ts) that idle-gates a pane, sends once, verifies delivery via cursor geometry, and emits push-undelivered on failure.
waitForIdlePane: pre-send gate (src/tmux/dispatch.ts:428) polling capture-pane until isOrchPaneIdle or the idleTimeoutMs deadline; returns a timedOut boolean.
sendOnceUnverified: the pane-not-idle fallback (src/tmux/dispatch.ts:479) that sends once and emits push-undelivered{retriesExhausted:1, reason:'pane-not-idle'} plus orch-pane-busy.
bootPane: the dispatch-geometry.test.ts harness that spawns the raw-echo fixture in a fresh tmux session on the private test socket and is the single setup path every test calls.
